using namespace std;

    vector<vector<int>> cache(n + 1, vector<int>(n + 1, -1));
    cache[0][0] = 1;

    function<long long(int, int)> count_structures = [&](int n, int h) -> long long {
        if (cache[n][h] != -1) {
            return cache[n][h];
        }
        if (n == 0) {
            return 0;
        }
        if (h == 0) {
            return count_structures(n, 1);

            total += count_structures(n - i - 1, 0) * count_structures(i, h - 1);
            total += count_structures(n - i - 1, h - 1) * count_structures(i, 0);
            total -= count_structures(n - i - 1, h - 1) * count_structures(i, h - 1);
        }

        cache[n][h] = total;
        return total;
